'''Harwakokok the Mighty''' was a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] and a member of the [[Kashyyyk resistance/Legends|Wookiee resistance]] on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. He was [[Death/Legends|killed]] during a three-way battle aboard the [[Avatar Orbital Platform]] between the resistance, the [[Blackscale Clan/Legends|Blackscale]] [[Slavery/Legends|slavers]], and a team of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] sent by a rival [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] slaver group to destroy the platform.

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Harwakokok appeared as a non-player character in the video game Star Wars Galaxies, a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by [[Sony]] and published by LucasArts, prior to its closure on [[December 15]], 2011.
